protocol.title: Spatiotemporal NF-kB Dynamics Encodes the Position, Amplitude, and Duration of Local Immune Inputs
protocol.platform: Custom two-chamber PDMS diffusion microfluidic chip with pneumatic membrane valve
cell_lines: p65-/- NIH 3T3 mouse embryonic fibroblasts (p65-DsRed NF-kB marker + H2B-GFP nucleus marker)
p65-/- RAW 264.7 macrophages (p65-GFP reporter; macrophage coculture arm only)
protocol.objective: Quantify spatiotemporal NF-kB dynamics in fibroblasts responding to a localized TNF cytokine gradient, demonstrate wave-like NF-kB propagation and sharply defined activation zones, decode cytokine dose/duration/distance from single-cell NF-kB dynamics, and resolve distance-specific proinflammatory gene expression patterns by spatially resolved RT-qPCR

device.fabrication: Standard soft lithography; PDMS (Momentive RTV-615, 10:1 ratio) cast on SU-8 masters

photoresist.valve_regions: Positive photoresist MicroChemicals AZ40XT, 20 um thickness
photoresist.channel_and_control_layer: Negative photoresist MicroChemicals SU-8 3025, 30 or 25 um thickness

device.oxygen_plasma_bonding: Harrick PDC-001, 30 s; chip bonded to clean glass slide

chambers.source_chamber: Cytokine or macrophage loading; pneumatically isolated by PDMS membrane valve
chambers.diffusion_chamber: Fibroblast receiving chamber; 2.5 mm length along diffusion axis
chambers.sink_channel: Bottom channel continuously perfused with fresh medium at 0.33 Hz (20 cycles/min) via on-chip peristaltic pumping to simulate capillary clearance

valve.control: Custom MATLAB GUI (modified from Gomez-Sjoberg et al. Anal. Chem. 2007)
valve.tubing: Tygon ND-100-80 with metal pins; PEEK tubing VICI TPK.505

stage_incubator.model: Life Imaging Service, Basel; Nikon Eclipse Ti2 stage-top incubator box

lps_macrophage_stimulation.notes: Used in macrophage coculture arm (Fig. 5) only; not encoded in primary TNF diffusion .bs file

fibroblast_medium.base: Fluorobrite Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DMEM; Gibco A1896701)

fibronectin_coating.application: Overnight coating of diffusion chamber PDMS surface; washed with fresh medium before cell seeding

reagents.cell_detachment: TrypLE Express (Gibco); 1-2 min on-chip before retrieval

lysis_buffer.notes: Ice-cold; lysate stored at -80 C until qPCR

reagents.rt_qpcr_kit: CellDirect One-Step RT-qPCR kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific)

A20_Tnfaip3.kinetics: early gene; rapidly induced and rapidly degraded upon NF-kB activation

Casp4.kinetics: late gene; slow activation, prolonged expression

RANTES_Ccl5.kinetics: late chemokine gene; slow activation, prolonged expression

imaging.stitching: 4 FOVs per chamber; custom MATLAB using detectSURFFeatures + estimateGeometricTransform
imaging.nfkb_analysis: Custom MATLAB image analysis pipeline; nucleus boundary from H2B-GFP; p65-DsRed nuclear intensity normalized to pre-valve basal level; lowess smoothing to reduce noise from cell migration/collisions
imaging.activation_threshold: 2 SDs above mean basal level per subregion

steps.name: Fibronectin surface coating of receiving chamber
steps.notes: 1 mg/mL fibronectin diluted 1:4 in PBS applied overnight to PDMS diffusion chamber to promote fibroblast adhesion. Channels washed with fresh medium before cell seeding.

steps.name: NIH 3T3 fibroblast seeding and attachment
steps.operation: flow-through seeding (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.side_channel_clearance: Non-adherent cells flushed with trypsin from side channels
steps.passaging: Trypsin-EDTA (Gibco); 1:10 resuspension before 100% confluency in flask
steps.notes: Paper M&M: fibroblasts loaded at ~80% confluency; waited at least 5 h with one or two feedings. Cells stuck in other channels removed by flushing with trypsin.

steps.name: TNF loading into source chamber
steps.notes: TNF (R&D Systems 410-MT) diluted in DMEM. Loaded into source chamber with pneumatic separator valve in closed position. 100 ng/mL primary condition encoded; 10 and 30 ng/mL also tested in paper (Fig. 3A).

steps.name: Valve open - TNF diffusion into receiving chamber
steps.operation: valve actuation + passive diffusion (abstracted as mix in BioScript)

diffusion_profile.notes: TNF concentration and kinetics vary with distance (Fig. 1E, fig. S4). Far cells experience lower peak dose and later onset, extending NF-kB activation duration.

steps.paper_ref: Fig. 3B: valve opened and closed after 15, 30, or 60 min. This file encodes 60 min condition.

steps.name: NF-kB fluorescence imaging window

observation.wave_propagation: Wave-like NF-kB propagation across 2.5 mm receiving chamber (Fig. 1H, Movie S2)
observation.activation_zone: Sharply defined; activation rate transitions from >75% to <25% within 0.4 mm (Fig. 1J)
observation.activation_duration_extension: Far cells show longer activation window due to slower TNF ramp (Fig. 1I blue interval)

steps.qc_threshold: >75% of cells in near region (0-0.4 mm) must activate (2 SDs above basal)

pass.interpretation: Wave propagation confirmed; proceed to gene expression arm

fail.interpretation: No detectable NF-kB activation (device failure or TNF degradation)

steps.name: Continued incubation to 8 h for gene expression time course
steps.paper_ref: Fig. 6C: cells collected at 0, 2, 4, and 8 hours after TNF release

steps.name: Spatially resolved cell retrieval from three chip regions
steps.operation: valve actuation + TrypLE detachment + lysis buffer collection
steps.paper_ref: Paper M&M: separating valves actuated to divide cell chamber into top, middle, and bottom sections; each position purged with PBS; cells in ~2 uL droplet collected onto glass slide

steps.name: RT-qPCR gene expression measurement (3 probes x 3 regions)
steps.reaction_assembly: Probes chained sequentially into each lysate to respect compiler single-consumption constraint (rxnNearA -> rxnNearAC -> rxnNearACR; same for Mid and Far)
steps.normalization: GAPDH housekeeping gene; DeltaCT method; fold change = 2^(DeltaDeltaCT)

expected_results.A20_near_2h: Strongly upregulated (early gene); highest near source; drops sharply with distance (Fig. 6C)
expected_results.Casp4_all_regions: Upregulated across near/mid/far at 8 h (late gene; distance-insensitive)
expected_results.RANTES_all_regions: Upregulated across near/mid/far at 8 h (late gene; distance-insensitive)

steps.name: Gene expression QC gate
steps.qc_criterion: A20 signal in near region must exceed 3 SDs above unstimulated baseline at 2 h

pass.interpretation: Valid A20 upregulation confirmed; all three spatial reactions disposed

fail.interpretation: qPCR failure or no detectable induction; all reactions drained

key_findings.wave_propagation: TNF diffusion coupled with intrinsic NF-kB network oscillations drives wave-like propagation of NF-kB activity, not paracrine signaling from fibroblasts (fig. S5)
key_findings.activation_zone: Sharply defined; transition from >75% to <25% activation within 0.4 mm (<15% of chamber length) for all source doses (Fig. 1J)
key_findings.dose_controls_range: Signaling range increases linearly with log(source dose); y = 0.89*log(x) - 1.80 (Fig. 3C)
key_findings.duration_controls_oscillations: Number of NF-kB oscillations correlates with stimulus duration, not dose; y = 0.023*x + 1.40 (Fig. 3C)
key_findings.dose_duration_independent: Dose and duration are two independent, orthogonal control dimensions of the NF-kB spatial response
key_findings.multidimensional_decoding: NF-kB dynamics simultaneously encodes dose (first peak height), distance (ratio of second to first peak height), and duration (oscillation count) in single cells (Figs. 4D-E)
key_findings.single_cell_accuracy: Decision tree cross-validation: 0.69-0.94 accuracy distinguishing dose and distance at single-cell level (Fig. 4F)
key_findings.gene_expression_zones: A20 (early) restricted near source; Casp4/RANTES (late) expressed across all distances; IRF-family genes more distance-insensitive than NF-kB-family genes (Figs. 6-7)
key_findings.macrophage_variability: Single macrophage secretion variability directly translates to variable NF-kB signaling range (0 to 2 mm) and oscillation count (0 to >3) across 35 coculture replicates (Fig. 5C)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: fibronectin coating, fibroblast seeding/attachment, TNF loading, valve open, TNF diffusion, imaging window, NF-kB detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_3_f
basic_blocks.action: dispose(imagingWindow) [drain normalized to dispose in IR]

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose(nfkbSignal); continued incubation, spatially resolved cell retrieval, RT-qPCR assembly, RT + PCR heat steps, gene expression detect

compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
compiler_notes.duration_units: s and m only; h token not supported
compiler_notes.drain_normalization: drain statements normalize to dispose in IR; expected compiler behavior
compiler_notes.manifest_note: LPS_Stimulant and RAW264_7_Macrophage declared in manifest for documentation of macrophage coculture arm (Fig. 5) but not dispensed in this file; no compile error raised
compiler_notes.dispensed_variable_constraint: Manifest names cannot appear directly as mix operands; all reagents must be assigned via dispense before use in mix
compiler_notes.consumed_variable_constraint: Variables consumed in mix cannot be reused in subsequent mix statements; continuedIncub staged into three separate chambX variables (pbsNear/Mid/Far); lysate probes chained sequentially (rxnNearA -> rxnNearAC -> rxnNearACR)
